propositions: _pai_check_config currently raises LLMConfigError for any base_url/api_key configuration, contradicting documented support for local OpenAI-compatible servers and already-present config parsing
the openai provider builder must inject base_url and api_key into OpenAIProvider, and override the model profile to set supports_json_schema_output=False for non-hosted endpoints

base_url is provider configuration not provider selection; REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER=openai remains the actual selector, and the builder registers only when base_url is set to avoid breaking lazy resolution for unmodified openai strings
the profile override must ride the Provider via a staticmethod override, not OpenAIChatModel(profile=...), because pydantic-ai's infer_model builds the model and rebar only returns the Provider
bare openai:gpt-4o without base_url must continue taking the lazy string path to preserve test compatibility and keep the openai SDK optional at runtime
